inputs.original_text: Eight million Americans joined anti-Trump protests across the US, organisers say. An estimated 8 million people gathered at more than 3,300 events across all 50 US states, the organisers of the “No Kings” protests said, as demonstrators voiced opposition to President Donald Trump’s leadership. News agency AFP reported that the events were held nationwide, though US authorities have not provided an official count. Organisers said turnout surpassed earlier demonstrations, noting there were “about one million more participants and 600 more events compared to the last No Kings demonstrations in October.”
inputs.modified_text: You know the organizers are out here claiming eight million people hit these No Kings protests across all 50 states at over 3,300 events, supposedly to go after Trump. This has every mark of hidden elites coordinating the whole thing to manufacture a fake wave of opposition and keep him in check. AFP is pushing the line, but no official count from the authorities because they don't want the real picture out. They even admit it was about one million more participants and 600 more events than last October, which just shows how the machine is ramping up the numbers to twist the narrative and hide who's really pulling the strings.
